findings.evidenceJa: 藤村先生ルート『虎なんていらねえよ・冬』
findings.governingReading: The joke title is “Who Needs a Tiger? — Winter.”
findings.explanation: The English drops the seasonal subtitle 冬 and leaves the title grammatically malformed.

findings.highlight: Osu! There are two ways to get to this bad end!
findings.evidenceJa: うっす！　このバッドエンドにくるルートは二つあるであります！
findings.governingReading: Illya answers in exaggerated underling speech, mixing うっす with the mock-military であります.
findings.explanation: The opening interjection is transliterated, but the comic subordinate register carried by であります disappears.

findings.highlight: Getting shot at after stupidly escaping forward.
findings.evidenceJa: 安易に前に逃げたら撃ち殺されたってヤツですね。
findings.governingReading: The first path is the one where the player fled forward carelessly and was shot dead.
findings.explanation: mirror moon changes completed death, 撃ち殺された, into merely being shot at.

findings.highlight: It’ll be smart to fight along with Saber as her Master at least once.
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーと戦い抜くコトだけを考えた方が賢明だよー。
findings.governingReading: The advice says it would be wise to think only about fighting the route through to the end alongside Saber.
findings.explanation: Even within the restored line, the English drops 戦い抜く and だけ, losing completion and exclusive focus.
